frame: Provisional frame: x forward, y to port, z up, metres. Origin x=0 at the stem (forward end of LOA, which is also the forestay deck point since SFJ=0), so points aft of the stem have negative x. y=0 on the centreline. z=0 on the ORC measurement-trim flotation plane (no crew, no sails), the plane the certificate freeboards are measured from. A later hull-morph task moves the origin to DWL midship. Section depths are measured down from each appendage's root section (Section 1).

material.value: lead-antimony, cast; fin and bulb are one casting; the upper fin is a GRP sump
material.source: J/80 Class Rules 2024 (effective 2024-06-01), E.2.1; J/Boats J/80 Tech Specs page
material.note: fin and bulb are one casting; the upper fin is a GRP sump

material_density.method: lead 11 340 and antimony 6 690 kg/m^3 mixed at about 4% Sb.

sections.source: J/80 Class Rules 2024 (effective 2024-06-01), Appendix H.1 Appendage Plan
sections.note: Minimum offsets. Section 1 is where the hull fairbody meets the moulded keel sump. All sections are parallel (horizontal). Half widths are absolute; each section is a NACA 4-digit symmetric (00xx) thickness form scaled to its own thickness. Thickness for sections 1-4 (0.100 m) is confirmed by the listed leading-edge radii.

tip.value: elliptical cross-sections below Section 8, about 0.050 m deep
tip.source: J/80 Class Rules 2024 (effective 2024-06-01), Appendix H.1 Appendage Plan
tip.note: The tip centreline profile column peaks at 50.0 mm, read as the depth below Section 8.

span.source: J/80 Class Rules 2024 (effective 2024-06-01), Appendix H.1 Appendage Plan

root_chord.source: J/80 Class Rules 2024 (effective 2024-06-01), Appendix H.1 Appendage Plan

fin_min_chord.source: J/80 Class Rules 2024 (effective 2024-06-01), Appendix H.1 Appendage Plan

leading_edge_sweep.source: J/80 Class Rules 2024 (effective 2024-06-01), Appendix H.1 Appendage Plan

trailing_edge.value: 1.0 mm half width at x/c = 1.0 (2 mm thick)
trailing_edge.source: J/80 Class Rules 2024 (effective 2024-06-01), Appendix H.1 Appendage Plan

fin_thickness.source: J/80 Class Rules 2024 (effective 2024-06-01), Appendix H.1 Appendage Plan
fin_thickness.note: constant 100 mm from Section 1 to Section 4

section_profile.source: J/80 Class Rules 2024 (effective 2024-06-01), Appendix H.1 Appendage Plan
section_profile.method: offset ratios Yc/Yc_max at all 16 stations match NACA 4-digit thickness to 0.001.

bulb_length.source: J/80 Class Rules 2024 (effective 2024-06-01), Appendix H.1 Appendage Plan

bulb_width.source: J/80 Class Rules 2024 (effective 2024-06-01), Appendix H.1 Appendage Plan

bulb_height.source: J/80 Class Rules 2024 (effective 2024-06-01), Appendix H.1 Appendage Plan
bulb_height.method: from Section 4 (0.880 m, last section at fin thickness) to the tip.

lateral_area.source: J/80 Class Rules 2024 (effective 2024-06-01), Appendix H.1 Appendage Plan
lateral_area.method: chord integrated over depth, with an elliptical tip.

volume_from_offsets.source: J/80 Class Rules 2024 (effective 2024-06-01), Appendix H.1 Appendage Plan
volume_from_offsets.method: section area 0.6851 * chord * thickness (NACA 4-digit), integrated trapezoidally over depth, plus an elliptical tip cap. These are minimum offsets.
volume_from_offsets.note: The keel's displaced volume, lead plus the GRP sump above it; not the lead volume (see lead_top_depth_below_root and mass.json keel_lead_volume).

lead_top_depth_below_root.source: J/80 Class Rules 2024 (effective 2024-06-01), Appendix H.1 Appendage Plan
lead_top_depth_below_root.method: depth below Section 1 at which the lead volume from the tip up equals 0.0577 m^3 (635 kg / 11 000 kg/m^3).

ballast_centroid.source: J/80 Class Rules 2024 (effective 2024-06-01), Appendix H.1 Appendage Plan
ballast_centroid.method: centroid of the lead portion, from the lead top depth to the tip; x inherits the root_leading_edge estimate.

root_z.source: J/80 Class Rules 2024 (effective 2024-06-01), Appendix H.1 Appendage Plan; ORC J/80 OD certificate 2019, p.1
root_z.method: z of Section 1 = -draft (1.501 m) + span (1.170 m).

root_fairing.profile: H.1 Section 1 (chord 0.96 m, t 0.100 m, NACA 00xx), extruded vertically from root_z up to the canoe-body surface
root_fairing.method: fills the gap between H.1 Section 1 and the morphed canoe body; height and volume are computed by tools/hull/morph.py and recorded in hull_hydro.json

root_leading_edge.source: J/80 Class Rules 2024 (effective 2024-06-01), Appendix H.1 Appendage Plan; ORC J/80 OD certificate 2019, p.1
root_leading_edge.method: No public drawing locates the keel fore and aft. The root leading edge is placed so the keel's volume centroid (0.618 m aft of the root LE) falls at the certificate LCF, 4.276 m from the stem, as a stand-in for LCB.

centroid.source: J/80 Class Rules 2024 (effective 2024-06-01), Appendix H.1 Appendage Plan
centroid.method: volume centroid of the offsets: 0.645 m below the root and 0.618 m aft of the root LE; x inherits the root_leading_edge estimate.

type.value: transom-hung, unbalanced; two pintles on the rudder into two gudgeons on the transom
type.source: J/80 Class Rules 2024 (effective 2024-06-01), E.2.5; J/80 Standard Building Specifications (1-Dec-20), item 34

sections.source: J/80 Class Rules 2024 (effective 2024-06-01), Appendix H.1 Appendage Plan
sections.note: Minimum offsets; leading edge vertical; NACA 0012 form (t/c 0.120 at Sections 1-2).

span_to_section_5.source: J/80 Class Rules 2024 (effective 2024-06-01), Appendix H.1 Appendage Plan
span_to_section_5.note: The table ends at Section 5; tip shape below it is not given.

root_chord.source: J/80 Class Rules 2024 (effective 2024-06-01), Appendix H.1 Appendage Plan

tip_chord.source: J/80 Class Rules 2024 (effective 2024-06-01), Appendix H.1 Appendage Plan

section_profile.source: J/80 Class Rules 2024 (effective 2024-06-01), Appendix H.1 Appendage Plan
section_profile.method: half width at x/c = 0.30 is 0.060 c at every section, and the offset ratios follow NACA 4-digit thickness.

lateral_area.source: J/80 Class Rules 2024 (effective 2024-06-01), Appendix H.1 Appendage Plan

stock_axis.method: pivot on the pintle line at the vertical leading edge, assumed 0.05 m aft of the transom (LOA 8.032 m). z is the root (Section 1), assumed at the waterplane where the blade leaves the transom; not given in any source.

tip_z.source: J/80 Class Rules 2024 (effective 2024-06-01), Appendix H.1 Appendage Plan

weight_min.note: including fixed gudgeons, tiller and tiller straps

foils.frame: Body frame: x forward, y to port, z up, metres; origin on the centreline at the midpoint of Lwl on the DWL (hull_hydro.json transform). Unlike the rest of this file, which is in the provisional frame.

span.source: J/80 Class Rules 2024 (effective 2024-06-01), Appendix H.1 Appendage Plan; appendages.obj from tools/hull/appendages.py
span.method: from the canoe body on the centreline (mean over the root chord) down to the keel tip; includes the root fairing

root_chord.source: J/80 Class Rules 2024 (effective 2024-06-01), Appendix H.1 Appendage Plan; appendages.obj from tools/hull/appendages.py
root_chord.method: chord of the mesh section at the root (Section 1)

tip_chord.source: J/80 Class Rules 2024 (effective 2024-06-01), Appendix H.1 Appendage Plan; appendages.obj from tools/hull/appendages.py
tip_chord.method: chord of the mesh section at the last table section
tip_chord.note: Section 8, the widest bulb section, directly above the 0.050 m elliptical tip; the fin's narrowest chord is 0.74 m at Sections 4-5

leading_edge_sweep.source: J/80 Class Rules 2024 (effective 2024-06-01), Appendix H.1 Appendage Plan; appendages.obj from tools/hull/appendages.py
leading_edge_sweep.method: least-squares slope of the mesh leading edge over the fin, Section 1 to Section 4 (above the bulb)

quarter_chord_sweep.source: J/80 Class Rules 2024 (effective 2024-06-01), Appendix H.1 Appendage Plan; appendages.obj from tools/hull/appendages.py
quarter_chord_sweep.method: least-squares slope of the mesh quarter-chord line over the fin, Section 1 to Section 4 (above the bulb)

thickness_chord_ratio_root.source: J/80 Class Rules 2024 (effective 2024-06-01), Appendix H.1 Appendage Plan; appendages.obj from tools/hull/appendages.py
thickness_chord_ratio_root.method: max thickness / chord of the mesh section at the root

thickness_chord_ratio_tip.source: J/80 Class Rules 2024 (effective 2024-06-01), Appendix H.1 Appendage Plan; appendages.obj from tools/hull/appendages.py
thickness_chord_ratio_tip.method: max thickness / chord of the mesh section at the tip_chord station

planform_area.source: J/80 Class Rules 2024 (effective 2024-06-01), Appendix H.1 Appendage Plan; appendages.obj from tools/hull/appendages.py
planform_area.method: chord of horizontal mesh sections integrated from the canoe body to the tip; includes the root fairing. The H.1 part (Section 1 to the tip) is planform_area_h1.

geometric_aspect_ratio.source: J/80 Class Rules 2024 (effective 2024-06-01), Appendix H.1 Appendage Plan; appendages.obj from tools/hull/appendages.py

effective_aspect_ratio.source: J/80 Class Rules 2024 (effective 2024-06-01), Appendix H.1 Appendage Plan; appendages.obj from tools/hull/appendages.py
effective_aspect_ratio.method: 2x geometric: the fin is attached to the hull with no gap, so the hull bottom acts as a reflection plane. An upper bound; heel and leeway lower it.
effective_aspect_ratio.note: An assumption, not a measurement; the physics may replace it with its own end-plate model.

quarter_chord_centre.source: J/80 Class Rules 2024 (effective 2024-06-01), Appendix H.1 Appendage Plan; appendages.obj from tools/hull/appendages.py
quarter_chord_centre.method: chord-weighted mean of the quarter-chord points of horizontal mesh sections over the span, i.e. the quarter-chord point at the planform area centroid's depth

wetted_area.source: J/80 Class Rules 2024 (effective 2024-06-01), Appendix H.1 Appendage Plan; appendages.obj from tools/hull/appendages.py
wetted_area.method: area of the mesh triangles whose centroid is below hull_visual.obj

volume_below_hull.source: J/80 Class Rules 2024 (effective 2024-06-01), Appendix H.1 Appendage Plan; appendages.obj from tools/hull/appendages.py
volume_below_hull.method: mesh volume minus its intersection with hull_physics.obj (manifold3d boolean): fin, bulb, tip and the root fairing below the canoe body

planform_area_h1.source: J/80 Class Rules 2024 (effective 2024-06-01), Appendix H.1 Appendage Plan
planform_area_h1.method: as planform_area, Section 1 down to the tip only; compare appendages.json keel lateral_area

root_overlap.method: the root fairing extends 0.020 m into the canoe body at every root vertex, so the overlap is 0.020 m times the Section 1 area (0.0657 m^2); volume_below_hull excludes it

root_fairing_height.method: range over the Section 1 outline of the height from root_z up to hull_visual.obj

span.source: J/80 Class Rules 2024 (effective 2024-06-01), Appendix H.1 Appendage Plan; appendages.obj from tools/hull/appendages.py
span.method: from the root at the flotation plane (appendages.json stock_axis z) down to Section 5; nothing below Section 5

root_chord.source: J/80 Class Rules 2024 (effective 2024-06-01), Appendix H.1 Appendage Plan; appendages.obj from tools/hull/appendages.py
root_chord.method: chord of the mesh section at the root (Section 1)

tip_chord.source: J/80 Class Rules 2024 (effective 2024-06-01), Appendix H.1 Appendage Plan; appendages.obj from tools/hull/appendages.py
tip_chord.method: chord of the mesh section at the last table section
tip_chord.note: Section 5; the blade ends flat there

leading_edge_sweep.source: J/80 Class Rules 2024 (effective 2024-06-01), Appendix H.1 Appendage Plan; appendages.obj from tools/hull/appendages.py
leading_edge_sweep.method: least-squares slope of the mesh leading edge over the whole span

quarter_chord_sweep.source: J/80 Class Rules 2024 (effective 2024-06-01), Appendix H.1 Appendage Plan; appendages.obj from tools/hull/appendages.py
quarter_chord_sweep.method: least-squares slope of the mesh quarter-chord line over the whole span

thickness_chord_ratio_root.source: J/80 Class Rules 2024 (effective 2024-06-01), Appendix H.1 Appendage Plan; appendages.obj from tools/hull/appendages.py
thickness_chord_ratio_root.method: max thickness / chord of the mesh section at the root

thickness_chord_ratio_tip.source: J/80 Class Rules 2024 (effective 2024-06-01), Appendix H.1 Appendage Plan; appendages.obj from tools/hull/appendages.py
thickness_chord_ratio_tip.method: max thickness / chord of the mesh section at the tip_chord station

planform_area.source: J/80 Class Rules 2024 (effective 2024-06-01), Appendix H.1 Appendage Plan; appendages.obj from tools/hull/appendages.py
planform_area.method: chord of horizontal mesh sections integrated from the root to Section 5

geometric_aspect_ratio.source: J/80 Class Rules 2024 (effective 2024-06-01), Appendix H.1 Appendage Plan; appendages.obj from tools/hull/appendages.py

effective_aspect_ratio.source: J/80 Class Rules 2024 (effective 2024-06-01), Appendix H.1 Appendage Plan; appendages.obj from tools/hull/appendages.py
effective_aspect_ratio.method: 1x geometric: transom-hung, so the root sits clear of the hull with no end plate. The free surface at the root acts partly as a reflection plane at low Froude number, which this ignores.
effective_aspect_ratio.note: An assumption, not a measurement; the physics may replace it with its own end-plate model.

quarter_chord_centre.source: J/80 Class Rules 2024 (effective 2024-06-01), Appendix H.1 Appendage Plan; appendages.obj from tools/hull/appendages.py
quarter_chord_centre.method: chord-weighted mean of the quarter-chord points of horizontal mesh sections over the span, i.e. the quarter-chord point at the planform area centroid's depth

wetted_area.source: J/80 Class Rules 2024 (effective 2024-06-01), Appendix H.1 Appendage Plan; appendages.obj from tools/hull/appendages.py
wetted_area.method: area of the mesh triangles below the flotation plane (the root face at z = 0 is excluded)

volume_below_hull.source: J/80 Class Rules 2024 (effective 2024-06-01), Appendix H.1 Appendage Plan; appendages.obj from tools/hull/appendages.py
volume_below_hull.method: mesh volume; the blade is clear of the hull, so none of it is inside hull_physics.obj

stock_position.source: J/80 Class Rules 2024 (effective 2024-06-01), Appendix H.1 Appendage Plan; ORC J/80 OD certificate 2019, p.1
stock_position.method: appendages.json rudder stock_axis converted to the body frame: on the vertical leading edge at the root

stock_axis_direction.source: J/80 Class Rules 2024 (effective 2024-06-01), Appendix H.1 Appendage Plan
stock_axis_direction.method: vertical, along the leading edge, which H.1 gives as vertical; the transom rake of the pintle line is not in any source
